name: EPIC 205918843
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 8.9 solar radii and 0.85 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 205918843 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 8.924211 (16th-84th percentiles 8.718046-9.243873), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 2,609 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.85 solar masses and 8.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,640 K at its surface.
